findings.title: No eval runner — 17 evals.json files, zero automated execution
findings.summary: All planning skills have evals.json with assertions but no script runs them. Regressions from skill edits are undetected.
findings.action: Add scripts/run_evals.py that iterates evals and reports pass/fail. Schema validation mode as minimum viable first step.

findings.title: bolt-launch deprecated but still registered as active skill
findings.summary: bolt-launch/SKILL.md is deprecated since 2026-05-05 but remains symlinked and the loom orchestrator still references it in text. Direct invocations would use stale behavior.
findings.action: Make bolt-launch a redirect-only stub. Remove symlink from .claude/skills/. Clean up loom/SKILL.md Stage 8 language.

findings.title: No token/cost tracking on loom pipeline runs
findings.summary: weave-cost tracks demo environment Agent Builder spend but not the pipeline's own token costs. The hive-token-optimization skill is in AGENTS.md routing but never called.
findings.action: Add Step 0 pointer in loom/SKILL.md directing SA to hive-token-optimization for pipeline session cost tracking.

findings.title: bolt-eck silently falls back to ECH without SA warning
findings.summary: DEPLOYMENT_TYPE=eck routes to bolt-eck which silently deploys using ECH patterns. SA gets no warning that they're getting the wrong deployment type.
findings.action: bolt-eck should HALT with an explicit warning block. Never silently fall through to ECH for a different deployment type.

findings.title: warp-discovery sync has no drift detection
findings.summary: After today's thread-qualify changes, warp-discovery/SKILL.md and system-prompt.md were manually resynced. No automated signal exists to catch future drift.
findings.action: Add a Step 0 git-log drift check in loom/SKILL.md that compares last-modified dates from components.md against the git log of upstream skills.

findings.title: Orchestrator preamble duplicates decisions.md prose verbatim
findings.summary: ~80 lines of loom/SKILL.md duplicate D-024, D-025, D-026 policy content from docs/decisions.md. Every pipeline invocation loads both.
findings.action: Replace inline policy summaries with pointer references. Keep behavioral instruction, remove rationale.

findings.title: Evals for thread-qualify, weave-script, weave-model don't cover today's additions
findings.summary: Customer Overview, Opportunity Overview, success_goals, and KPI field pass were added today with no corresponding eval assertions.
findings.action: Add eval cases asserting new fields are populated in each skill's output.

findings.title: wind_pulse.py has no configurable request timeout
findings.summary: urllib.request calls have no timeout argument. On slow or unreachable clusters, a pre-demo pulse check could hang for 60-120 seconds per call.
findings.action: Add PULSE_TIMEOUT_SECS env var (default 10) and pass timeout= to all urlopen() calls.

findings.title: Pipeline-wide reference files namespaced under deprecated bolt-launch
findings.summary: inference-config.md, env-reference.md, terraform-patterns.md etc. live in bolt-launch/references/ but are used by finish-verify, bolt-ech, bolt-serverless, bolt-bootstrap.
findings.action: Move bolt-launch/references/ to skills/references/ and update all cross-references. No content changes needed.

findings.title: No model-tiering guidance across pipeline stages
findings.summary: Stages with very different complexity requirements (warp-listen extraction vs weave-script narrative) use the same model with no guidance.
findings.action: Add Model tier column to loom orchestrator stage table annotating which stages benefit from the best model vs fast model.

findings.title: Eval fixtures use real-sounding customer names
findings.summary: warp-listen evals reference Citizens Bank, IHG, Thermo Fisher, Lowe's with detailed meeting notes. Need to confirm these are synthetic composites, not real engagement data.
findings.action: Add comment confirming synthetic data. If real, anonymize.

findings.title: No mid-pipeline progress report
findings.summary: The loom orchestrator ends each stage silently. SA has no 'you are here' signal during long multi-stage runs.
findings.action: Add one-line completion banner after each stage: '✅ Stage N complete — {artifact}. Proceeding to Stage N+1.'

findings.title: weave-pipe and wind-streams are undeveloped stubs
findings.summary: Both have skeleton SKILL.md files with no step structure. May be triggered by orchestrator under the right conditions.
findings.action: Add 'status: planned' to frontmatter and 'Not yet implemented' header.

findings.title: No data retention guidance for engagement directories
findings.summary: Customer discovery notes land in ~/engagements/{slug}/ with no guidance on retention, encryption at rest, or git hygiene.
findings.action: Add 'Engagement data hygiene' section to AGENTS.md.

findings.title: External dependencies (hive-mind, elastic/agent-skills) are unpinned
findings.summary: Both are referenced by local path / latest-clone with no version pinning. Breaking changes could affect loom silently on next pull.
findings.action: Add docs/dependency-pins.md recording git SHA or version of each external dependency.
